selection: Use genuine publicly available revisions, without generated replacements or artificial mutations.

Exclude all previously inspected series, including ECMA-404, ECMA-367, HTTP Problem Details, language tags RFC 1766/3066, and every existing corpus series. Also exclude IRS 941, 1065, and 1120, consumed by the terminal-band fix. Also exclude Forms 940, 990, 1041, and 1042, inspected in the fourth experiment.

Select and annotate using source material only. Record the actual identity or boundary evidence supporting a scoped correspondence; textual similarity alone is insufficient under this implementation's declared contract.
Prefer different publishers or producer families. Report the observed diversity and the supported scope; two series do not establish universal PDF accuracy.
Keep every acquisition and selector failure, with its reason. Replace invalid source trials transparently before inspecting comparison outputs.

Before declaring a scope scorable for an established claim, inspect both source evidence inventories for an actual shared identity or other independently validated correspondence premise. A visually matching heading or similar prose is not a source identity. Record absent or unusable premises as failed source trials before any comparison.
annotation: Freeze input URLs, acquisition time, bytes, SHA-256, producer metadata, reviewed page images, complete review scopes, exact changed ranges, and globally unique source selectors before comparison.
Review both the visible passage and raw source coordinates. Record any missing glyph-space, normalization ambiguity, or reading-order discrepancy explicitly.

Check exact-mask identifiability independently of the comparison implementation: a changed word's display extent does not mean that every character changed. Preserve repeated-character alternatives and reject unentailed exact masks.
Never feed expected IDs, annotation boundaries, or pair names into production comparison.

Before freezing, require the literal scalar set selected by every annotation range to equal the independently reviewed expected changed set. Do not filter whitespace out of the selected expected set during validation. Layout-whitespace exclusions must be represented by split annotation ranges before any comparison output.

execution.configuration: candidate4-limits.txt, with limit scale 1.0 and no post-output limit changes
execution.retention: All route reports, source coverage, inference, search status, process failures, time, and peak RSS remain visible.

acceptance: Recover every predeclared required changed event as one established operation with its exact old/new source mask; inferred results and assembled fragments do not pass.
Zero false positives in the independently reviewed unchanged context.

Controls require zero established changes and complete comparison coverage for the predeclared claimed scope. Zero operations or global coverage counts alone do not prove that a specific scope was compared.

Any scoped control proof must bind the reviewed source set to the actual successful, non-inferred comparisons and account for extraction uncertainty affecting that scope. Retain broader document/channel incompleteness explicitly.
Report every selected channel even when only a text scope is scoreable; partial document coverage is never a complete document/no-change pass.
A holdout-informed implementation fix consumes the series. Retain the failed result, freeze a new implementation, and select new series.
interpretation: This source-eligibility check enforces the existing established-correspondence requirement; it does not upgrade a heuristic premise or remove previous frozen failures. Scope-limited success does not establish accuracy for all PDFs.
implementation_reuse: Candidate4 executable and all limits are unchanged. Its full corpus replay remains authoritative for this experiment; no redundant replay is required solely for new annotations.
